description: session.rs AUTH handler (line 334) gates on !is_tls without considering is_submission. When is_submission=true and is_tls=false, the EHLO correctly advertises AUTH PLAIN (line 296: is_tls || is_submission), but the AUTH command handler immediately returns 530 or 534 because the !is_tls branch fires before is_submission is checked. Mail clients on port 587 without TLS will see AUTH in EHLO and then be rejected when they attempt to use it. Fix: change the AUTH handler guard from 'if !is_tls' to 'if !is_tls && !is_submission'. Also add a test with is_submission=true, is_tls=false that verifies AUTH PLAIN succeeds. This was introduced in commit 573763b — the fix correctly removed tls_acceptor.is_some() from EHLO advertisement but did not update the corresponding command handler guard.
title: smtp: AUTH PLAIN rejected on submission port (is_submission=true, is_tls=false) despite being advertised
